# do_WafflePlot() | Pictogram proportions

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Waffle plots display proportions as a 10x10 grid of tiles, providing an intuitive visual representation.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_WafflePlot(sample = sample,
                           group.by = "seurat_clusters")
p
```
